title: The Quiet Smile
author: Mirabel Blackwood
blurb: Theo Joubert, a property surveyor appraising a house that appraises back, keeps the lights on and the doors counted. Then all the photographs from grandma's house now include an extra chair — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must finish the ritual the founders started before the harvest moon rises.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
